name: Artillery Cannon Belt (Feeder)
description: Cannon ammo belts can store and transfer ammo shells. Feeder belts transfer ammo forwards using electric power. Spawned ammo type can be set in component properties window.

logicNodes.label: Feed
logicNodes.description: Transfer shells in the direction of the arrow.

logicNodes.label: Contains Ammo
logicNodes.description: Returns true if the belt contains a shell.
